corrections.title: RETRACTED: the verify-artifact discovery failure was cwd drift, not an artifact-naming defect. Superseded by entry-cand-20260729-4.
corrections.cause: Refuted by the raw session transcript, not re-derived: the summary file existed under exactly the name and location the agent globbed for. The real failure was cwd drift — the agent had cd'd into .task/verify and then used a worktree-relative glob, so it resolved against the wrong directory — and the agent self-corrected 19 seconds later. There is no artifact-naming defect and no error-cascade defect here. The phenomenon is owned by entry-cand-20260729-4 ("Bash cwd persists across turns"), which is where a recurrence belongs. Leo ruled option (b) on esc-5120-2, 2026-09-08; task 5120 was cancelled.
corrections.note: CORRECTION (task 5198, esc-5120-2, Leo ruled option (b) 2026-09-08). This entry's title and cause are withdrawn and it is retired. It ANNOTATES rather than retracts its three prior sightings (sessions 273579c5-e299-40c6-ab02-e4c0ab24213b @2026-08-31, 8a483603-92b1-460b-8af1-65c02d70a598 @2026-09-05, d83f509f-a7e5-4eeb-9e2b-74e80289204b @2026-09-05): each was a true observation of a real symptom, and only the cause they were filed under was refuted. Two of the three were the legibility census quoting its own error string back to itself — one session "directly instantiating this candidate", one periodic-census verifier session "confirming this candidate is still observable" — which is what made this entry self-ingesting and growing. The refutation came from reading the raw session transcript and is not re-derived here: the file existed under exactly the globbed name, and the failure was cwd drift that self-corrected 19 seconds later. Task 5120 was cancelled. A recurrence of the refuted framing is now dropped before any LLM call by the fused-memory/config/cancelled_premise_blocklist.yaml entry verify_summary_glob_jsondecodeerror_refuted, consulted by fused_memory/middleware/task_curator.py::_maybe_blocklist_drop.
